title: On the Transitive Binary $G$-Spaces
summary: Distributive subsets of the group of all invertible continuous binary operations on a topological space are considered, and it is proved that the subgroups generated by them are also distributive. A criterion for the distributivity of a binary action of a topological group $G$ on a space $X$ is obtained. The concept of transitive binary $G$-space is introduced, and a classification of transitive distributive binary $G$-spaces is given in the case of a compact group $G$.
